content_of_post_to_comment: We already have the technology and resources to cut the work week in half and still provide basic necessities to everyone. Why should we continue slaving away for the capitalist class? They are part of a cult of economic growth and what’s best for society does not interest them.
comment: The harder question may be less about technology and more about power: who gets to decide how productivity gains are distributed? A shorter work week requires a shift in bargaining power, not just better tools.
